title: Publish trail closure notices
body:
# Publish trail closure notices

## Problem
Hikers set out for a trail that rangers have already closed, because the closure is only pinned to a board at the trailhead.

## Objectives
- Hikers can see which trails are closed before they set out.
- Rangers can take a notice down when a trail reopens.

## Maturity
- marlin: early

## Acceptance Criteria
- **AC1.** A ranger can post a closure notice for a trail. *Verified by: manual check.*
- **AC2.** A closure notice shows on the page for that trail and is emailed to hikers who follow that trail. *Verified by: manual check.*
- **AC3.** A ranger can take a closure notice down when the trail reopens. *Verified by: manual check.*
